t: 亚历山大·涅夫斯基率领的诺夫哥罗德军队在涅瓦战役中击败了瑞典人.
te: A Novgorodian army led by Alexander Nevsky defeats the Swedes in the Battle of the Neva.
dz: 瑞典-诺夫哥罗德战争:亚历山大·涅夫斯基率领的诺夫哥罗德军队在涅瓦战役中击败了瑞典人.
de: Swedish–Novgorodian Wars: A Novgorodian army led by Alexander Nevsky defeats the Swedes in the Battle of the Neva.

t: 英格兰国王约翰因为支持史蒂芬·朗顿大主教而驱逐了坎特伯雷僧侣.
te: King John of England expels Canterbury monks for supporting Archbishop Stephen Langton.
dz: 英格兰国王约翰因为支持史蒂芬·朗顿大主教而驱逐了坎特伯雷僧侣.
de: King John of England expels Canterbury monks for supporting Archbishop Stephen Langton.

t: 重建后的圣塞普尔教堂被尊为耶路撒冷.
te: The reconstructed Church of the Holy Sepulchre is consecrated in Jerusalem.
dz: 重建后的圣塞普尔教堂被尊为耶路撒冷.
de: The reconstructed Church of the Holy Sepulchre is consecrated in Jerusalem.

t: 基督教士兵在艰难的围攻中进行最后的进攻后占领了耶路撒冷的圣墓教堂。
te: Christian soldiers take the Church of the Holy Sepulchre in Jerusalem after the final assault of a difficult siege.
dz: 第一次十字军东征：基督教士兵在艰难的围攻中进行最后的进攻后占领了耶路撒冷的圣墓教堂。
de: First Crusade: Christian soldiers take the Church of the Holy Sepulchre in Jerusalem after the final assault of a difficult siege.

t: 唐玄宗奉禁军之命，处决宰相杨国忠，迫使他自杀或叛变。安禄山将军杀害了其他皇亲国戚。
te: Emperor Xuanzong of Tang is ordered by his Imperial Guards to execute chancellor Yang Guozhong by forcing him to commit…
dz: 安禄山之乱：唐玄宗奉禁军之命，处决宰相杨国忠，迫使他自杀或叛变。安禄山将军杀害了其他皇亲国戚。
de: An Lushan Rebellion: Emperor Xuanzong of Tang is ordered by his Imperial Guards to execute chancellor Yang Guozhong by forcing him to commit suicide or face a mutiny. General An Lushan has other members of the emperor's family killed.

t: 提图斯和他的军队攻破了耶路撒冷的城墙。 （希伯来历搭模斯月 17 日）。
te: Titus and his armies breach the walls of Jerusalem. (17th of Tammuz in the Hebrew calendar).
dz: 第一次犹太罗马战争：提图斯和他的军队攻破了耶路撒冷的城墙。 （希伯来历搭模斯月 17 日）。
de: First Jewish–Roman War: Titus and his armies breach the walls of Jerusalem. (17th of Tammuz in the Hebrew calendar).

t: 古罗马卡斯托和波卢克圣殿的奉献.
te: Dedication of the Temple of Castor and Pollux in ancient Rome.
dz: 古罗马卡斯托和波卢克圣殿的奉献.
de: Dedication of the Temple of Castor and Pollux in ancient Rome.
